'''Oviparous''' [[Species/Legends|species]] produced undeveloped [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] that hatched outside the maternal body, rather than live young.<ref name="WFG">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> Most reptiles were oviparous.<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> Example of non reptilian species that used that [[Reproduction/Legends|reproductive]] mode included [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusks]] like the [[Swamp slug/Legends|swamp slugs]], [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]] like the [[Peko-peko/Legends|peko-peko]],<ref name="WFG" /> [[Bird/Legends|avians]] like the [[Pylat bird/Legends|Pylat birds]],<ref name="DOP Decoded">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace|d=y}}</ref> and [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] like the [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]].<ref name="CSWE III 145">{{CSWECite|III|145|Shawda Ubb}}.</ref><ref name="AA" /> Although untypical, some [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]], like the [[S'kytri]], were oviparous.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
